opening.argument: The footage shows David Nalbandian hitting forehands and backhands from behind the practice court at the BNP Paribas Open. The surrounding promotion stays within tennis instruction: it offers a free Forehand Masterclass, while the end card points viewers to slow-motion tennis footage and invites them to subscribe. Those requests do not turn the practice footage into a deceptive transaction. The supplied material describes no investment solicitation, payment requirement, credential request, or transaction outcome, and it provides no basis to claim a loss or deceptive intent.
